text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'kestrel-enterprise' reached 100% GPU allocation, queue depth spiked to 620, 30m sustained
rohit.oncall: paging @jamie.sre and @leah.runtime — I'm oncall, paging SRE rotation :phone:
jamie.sre: ack, looking. can you share the heap of queued jobs?
rohit.oncall: attaching short snapshot from metrics: 
```
GPU_utilization: 99.8%
queued_tasks: 620 (p95 wait 18s)
eviction_events: 0
burst_available: enabled but policy locks to org-tier:enterprise-only
```
leah.runtime: quick read: it's single-tenant saturation (Kestrel). Autoscale didn't kick — controller logged throttledCreate due to account quota check failing. suspect quota flag mismatch after recent quota change.
jamie.sre: if autoscale blocked, we can either: 1) temporarily grant burst into shared pool (policy allows with approval), 2) increase per-GPU concurrency for their models (risk latency), 3) failover specific endpoints to hosted fallback models (requires AC signoff).
rohit.oncall: priority is customer availability > latency. recommend burst for 2h while we fix quota issue.
leah.runtime: agree. quick mitigation: toggle tenant-burst and create a limited burst-cap (max 6 extra GPUs) + throttle to 50 rps. I can run command if we greenlight.
maria.pm: flagging account team. I'll let Kestrel know we're enabling emergency capacity and will follow up with a more formal note. Tanya, can you prepare an outbound?
tanya.support: on it. draft: "We're seeing elevated queueing on your dedicated pool; we've opened emergency capacity while we investigate. You may see minor latency changes; no data exposure." will post after internal approval.
jamie.sre: go ahead, leah — run the burst enable but keep hard caps and circuit breaker. Please paste the command here so we can audit.
leah.runtime: running: 
```
rictl tenant-burst-set --tenant kestrel-enterprise --enable true --max-gpus 6 --duration 2h --max-rps 50 --dry-run false
```
leah.runtime: command returned OK, starting allocation now. provisioning 3/6 GPUs, expected steady ramp over 90s.
rohit.oncall: monitoring logs. queue dropping: 620 -> 210 -> 90 in 4m. p95 latency up slightly but throughput restored. :white_check_mark:
jamie.sre: nice. open task to rollback after 2h or earlier if autoscale fixed. Leah, what's root cause follow-up?
leah.runtime: controller refused scale due to account-quota-check:policy_version mismatch after Tuesday's quota bump. will open PR to reconcile policy and add a safer metric to not block autoscale in single-tenant critical path.
maria.pm: Kestrel account notified. They asked for ETA — told them we have temporary capacity and will provide 2h update.
tanya.support: outbound sent to Kestrel points of contact with incident link: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1977777000>. included mitigation steps and expected rollback window.
jamie.sre: ok. action items: 1) leah - reconcile quota policy and hotfix autoscale within 2h, 2) rohit - keep monitoring + prepare postmortem notes, 3) maria/tanya - customer comms + exec summary.
leah.runtime: started hotfix branch, pushing now. ETA 45m for canary, 90m for global.
rohit.oncall: I'll extend oncall window if needed. tagging incident severity: sev2 (single enterprise impact, mitigated).
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: burst enabled for kestrel-enterprise (max_gpus=6, duration=2h). created incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1977777000/page
jamie.sre: great. once autoscale is healthy we'll drain burst and set to cooldown. please add the following to postmortem: ambiguous quota policy allowed autoscale to be blocked, improve telemetry around quota-check failures.
maria.pm: noted. I'll schedule customer follow-up call in 3h to confirm restoration and collect impact details.
tanya.support: logging timestamps and customer-reported errors. will attach to incident page.
rohit.oncall: last check before handoff — queue at 12, GPUs at 78% now, no dropped requests. handing off to next oncall @jamie.sre for follow-up.
jamie.sre: taking it. will update incident page and draft postmortem after root cause confirmed. :memo:
